Standalone full-orbit enumerations and exact mod-two boundaries matched fourteen instances; they are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full primary-text comparison: Wachs (2003) develops symmetric-group homology of matching complexes and uniform colored multigraph inflations; Mondal et al. (2023/24) develop nonequivariant topology, including the M7 torsion. None states or entails the geometric involution-fixed classification by cycle type. Existing finite matching-character statements concern another homotopy invariant, and own existing higher matching fixed-space statements concern a different complex. The new orbit reduction and cone recurrence supply the missing steps. Unindexed equivalents remain possible.
residual_risks: A differently formulated result about fixed points of matching complexes may exist in unindexed equivariant homotopy or finite group poset literature.

The classification can be placed in the broad setting of colored matching complexes; a future stronger theorem specialized with nonobvious reductions might cover it. No such direct implication was established from inspected source statements.
